description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another modified creature.
When the creature dies, Guardian of the Forgotten triggers, manifesting the top card of your library.
When the manifested card enters the battlefield, Gylwain and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Gylwain trigger, creating a Role token attached to the manifested creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
